name: Safety and Health Officer (SHO) statutory appointment

specifications.metric: project contract price threshold making SHO appointment mandatory for builders
specifications.basis: DOSH 'Petunjuk Prestasi SHO / SHO Performance Indicators' page read 25 Nov 2026, 'Updated Date: 16/03/2026': 'The appointment of an SHO is encouraged among client companies and designers, but mandatory for builders if the construction work has a total project contract price exceeding RM20 million.' Regulation 12 of the Safety and Health Officer Regulations 1997 allows DOSH to refuse renewal of SHO

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the GEG plant WBS sweep.
